c-sm-compare.label: Comparing and ordering fractions
c-sm-compare.summary: Put fractions against a common yardstick (a decimal, or a benchmark like 0.6) instead of finding a common denominator.

c-sm-bodmas.label: BODMAS with nested fractions
c-sm-bodmas.summary: Work from the innermost bracket outwards, keep fractions exact, and estimate first so options can be struck.

q-sm-order.label: Arrange fractions in order
q-sm-order.summary: Four fractions to put in ascending or descending order.

q-sm-bodmas.label: Evaluate nested brackets and mixed numbers
q-sm-bodmas.summary: Brackets inside brackets, mixed numbers and a division; or a very plain sum with decimals.

formulas.text: a/b < c/d  ⇔  a×d < c×b   (cross-multiply, b and d positive)
formulas.note: Or compare each fraction with a benchmark such as 1/2 or 0.6.

formulas.text: Closer to 1 means a smaller gap: a/b = 1 − (b − a)/b
Order: Brackets (innermost first), Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction
formulas.note: Mixed numbers: change 8⅓ to 25/3 before any division.
Dividing by a fraction is multiplying by its flip.

q-sm-order.cue: 'Arrange the fractions … in ascending / descending order.'
q-sm-order.standard: Convert each to a decimal (5/9 = 0.556, 4/7 = 0.571, 3/5 = 0.6, 7/11 = 0.636) and sort.
q-sm-order.fast: Pick a benchmark like 3/5 = 0.6 and sort the others into 'below' and 'above' (cross-multiply once each).
q-sm-order.eliminate: Look at the first and last item of each option. 3/5 is bigger than 5/9 and 4/7, so it cannot be first. That alone removes two options.

q-sm-bodmas.cue: A long expression with brackets inside brackets, mixed numbers and ÷, or a short one with decimals.
q-sm-bodmas.fast: Estimate while you work: 8.33 − (0.78 ÷ 0.18) ≈ 8.33 − 4.4 ≈ 3.9. Only 95/24 ≈ 3.96 is near.
q-sm-bodmas.eliminate: Estimate the whole expression to one decimal; options with the wrong sign or size go at once (−41/15 is negative, 32/3 is above 10).
traps: Doing the division before the bracket.
Adding instead of subtracting inside the middle bracket.

q-sm-continued.cue: A fraction whose denominator contains another fraction, stacked.
q-sm-continued.eliminate: The value is a little above 3 (3 + a fraction less than 1/2). Options above 3.5 or below 3 are out.
traps: Adding 1/3 to 5 and forgetting to flip before adding 2.
